dataList.content:
It's been a long while since I was able to relax like this, all alone in my room with not a concern in my mind.
也许是因为压在心头上的沉重包袱已经卸了下来。

Maybe it's because a heavy burden had been lifted from my heart.
我在自己的房间里享受着惬意的休息时光，并感受到久违的宁静。

I told the Sinners that we should take a day off or so in our respective rooms. After what happened... we deserved a good rest.
我告诉罪人们，我们在历经千辛万苦完成了这项工作之后，可以在自己的房间内休息上一天。

... A big part of that decision was also to relieve Yi Sang of his seasickness at least for a day. (I don't think the Sinners' rooms sway with the waves.)
……当然，这个决策的很大一部分原因是为了还未从晕船中恢复过来的李箱。（我并不觉得罪人们的房间也会随着海浪而摇晃。）

We're still a ways away from getting out of the Great Lake. I thought it would be a good idea to have a day like this where we could just sit and relax.
离开大湖还需要很长一段时间。我想，留出一天让我们好好坐下来放松一下会是个好主意。

Of course, this wasn't like a real vacation or anything. If anything were to happen, this little time off would be over just like that.
当然，这并不是真正的休假之类的活动。所以一旦发生什么事情，这假期就会转瞬即逝……

... Like that eardrum-tearing siren of Mephistopheles that always finds the worst times to go off, for example.
例如，总是会在最不适宜的时刻突然响起的梅菲斯托费勒斯的那震耳欲聋的警报声。

... Yeah.
……好吧。

I had a feeling that something like this was going to happen.
我有预感，事情最后会变成这样。

I'm not even upset at this point.
我的内心对此已经毫无波澜了。

This siren better be worth getting off our bums for...
这次……它最好是真的有用的警报……
dataList.place:
Cabins of Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 船舱

dataList.content:
There was naught to do in our respective chambers anyway, Heathcliff! I imagine that the time spent alone in thy room must have been quite dreary, indeed!
反正在各自的房间里也没什么事可做不是么！希斯克利夫先生呆在房间里想必也会觉得非常枯燥乏味！

Tsk, I can be a contemplative man from time to time, alright?
嘁，我也是那种喜欢沉思的人好吧……

GASP! For truth?!
什！真的吗？

... Oi, Clockhead. One clock-turnin' coming right up. This'll be the last one in a while, so just take one for the team, alright?
……钟表头。一时半会也没什么要救人的活，今天就转他个一人份的吧。没关系吧？

<... Aren't you going to ask Vergilius for permission, too?>
<……你不去征求一下维吉里乌斯的意见真的好吗？>

... Agh, bollocks.
……咳！令人火大！

... I think I'm starting to get a handle on how to manage Heathcliff.
……我想我已经渐渐掌握应对希斯克利夫的诀窍了。

Good news, Heathcliff.
好消息，希斯克利夫。

This volatility alarm seems to be something we can make use of.
此次的警报似乎很有意义。

<Then...>
<那么……>

Indeed. A notable change has occurred in one of the Mirror Dungeon doors.
正是，镜像迷宫那边的门发生了一次有意义的变化。

Dante, the short downtime you suggested...
但丁，您所提议的休假……

<Yeah, I know... I knew something like this was going to happen anyway.>
<我明白……我就知道会变成这样。>

... I see. Then, let us investigate the area where the volatility was detected.
……了解。那么，让我们前往检测到变化的地方吧。

There was something odd about the way Faust and Vergilius were looking at me, but...
虽然有些在意迷之叹息的浮士德和维吉里乌斯的视线，但……

... I was too busy to worry about the two of them. I had to somehow convince the Sinners, who had their long-awaited proper break taken away from them as soon as it started, to get to work.
……目前更重要的是，我得带着罪人们前往镜像迷宫。而且还要想方设法安抚他们，毕竟他们难得的假期已经结束了。

Hm. Another locked door has opened... The 'Keep Out' tapes have also disappeared.
一直以来被封锁的地方，又敞开一扇门了……

The door looks a bit... blueish this time, doesn't it?
这次的门显得稍微蓝一些……？

Where did the other doors go...? I don't think they were blue like this.
其他原来的门哪去了……？我觉得它们并不是这种颜色的。

The door did look a bit blue this time. Looks like every new Mirror Dungeon door will have a different design.
正如以实玛利所说，镜像迷宫每次新出现的门都是新款式。

... And disappear from time to time, I guess...
但它们似乎也会消失……

<I can hear... rolling waves from the other side, I think.>
<我好像能听到门后传来波涛滚滚的声响。>

According to the information relayed to us via the device, it appears that the official designation for this new area summoned by the Backdoor volatility will be 'Mirror of the Lake'.
根据设备向我们提供的信息，此次后门变化产生的新空间似乎被命名为“湖之镜”。

Ishmael's eyebrows twitched.
以实玛利的眉头稍稍皱起。

This is exactly what happened after we wrapped up Yi Sang's business...
上次解决李箱先生的情况后似乎也是如此……

... It seems too convenient to call it a coincidence, doesn't it? It's like these areas are tailor-made for each Sinners. Faust?
……与其说是随机生成新的空间，倒不如说是与罪人关系相当密切的变化，不是吗，浮士德小姐？

... Mephistopheles' engine is designed to change and adapt every time a Golden Bough is retrieved.
……梅菲斯托费勒斯的引擎，是会在每次回收金枝时都能够对其进行共鸣的设计。

And the Backdoor is also a product of the engine.
巴士的后门也是通过引擎的能力所制成的。

It would not be a reach to theorize that the 'incidents' with each Sinner would affect the engine, which in turn influences the contents of the Backdoor.
受到与金枝有直接关联的罪人们的“事件”的影响也不是绝无可能。

In other words, it's pretty much a guarantee that with each Golden Bough retrieval, we'll be getting a new 'zone', from now on.
也就是说，可以确定以后每当回收其他金枝的时候都会生成新的空间。

Quite likely, yes.
概率较高。

Okay... Yeah, thanks for the explanation.
原来如此……好的，感谢说明。

Ishmael's willingness to sharply and boldly question all things suspicious did not change at all, but... (Or maybe she just didn't like the fact that the word 'lake' was even brought up.)
虽然以实玛利特有的那种尖锐地指出有疑问的部分的语调并没有改变……（只是对“湖”这个字眼变得有些敏感了也说不定。）

... after the events at the Great Lake, maybe she was starting to take care not to be as blunt and scathing toward her fellow Sinners. Not more than necessary, anyway.
可能是以大湖上一系列的事件作为契机，我感觉以实玛利正在留意着尽量不对其他罪人过分刻薄。

... That's good. I'm relieved.
……挺好的，这是一种好的转变。

Wait. That raises another question.
稍等。还有一个问题。

Do ask.
请讲。

Are the Golden Boughs not immediately shipped to the headquarters by the After Team as soon as we retrieve them? How can they affect the engines if they're not here?
我明明听到过金枝在回收后，会经由LCCA移送至本部。金枝甚至不位于此处都能造成这样的影响吗？

... The answer to that question requires a rather lengthy explanation.
……对于该提问的回答，可能需要较长的时间。

I care not.
无所谓。

<W-wait. Outis. How about we try to wrap this up as quickly as we can?>
<别、别吧……奥提斯。现在就尽量长话短说吧。>

... Hurk.
……唔。

<We better get to someplace that's not constantly swaying. Yi Sang's really not having a good time out here...>
<好像尽快转移到其他空间才能让李箱感到稍微舒缓一些……>

I did not take my medicine... for I assumed that we would be having a brief respite... I beg your forgiveness...
本以为能有一段不短的假期，便没有吃药……抱歉……

... I'll hear just the summary, then.
……那就只听结论吧。

In summary... once the Golden Bough is retrieved, and when Limbus Company headquarters goes through a certain tuning process...
简而言之，金枝被回收后会被转移到本部，经过特定的步骤进行调律。

... Mephistopheles' Engine and the Golden Bough's wavelengths will overlap, causing a resonance effect.
调律结束后，梅菲斯托费勒斯的引擎和金枝发出的波长会相互吻合并引起共鸣。

... Which is a process that involves resonating with the Golden Bough in your head as well, Manager.
……也会和经理头里的金枝一起共鸣。

<T-that's how it works?>
<是、是那样的吗？>

Does that process not harm the Executive Manager?
那个过程不会对经理造成伤害吗？

No. As you have witnessed it yourself.
嗯，不会。正如您一路所见。

Hm. So once it is retrieved... the Golden Bough continues to affect those it resonated with. I see.
嗯。一旦回收就会有反应吗。知道了。

Guys~ Are we done with the boring lectures?
喂~无聊的说明时间结束了吗？

E.W.T.L.
快·讲。

'Enough with the lecture'...
她说快点结束讲课……

<Faust, this Dungeon... we have to enter it now, don't we?>
<浮士德，现在就得确认这个迷宫内部了吧？>

It felt like I was going back on my promise, after telling everyone that we could relax. I didn't like this one bit.
明明刚让罪人们去休息就要出尔反尔，心里颇有些过意不去……

But... I think I already knew what Faust was going to say.
不知为什么，我好像可以预料到浮士德的回答了。

Faust suggests that we explore the new zone as soon as we are able.
浮士德想建议您尽快探索新的空间。

Mephistopheles is still at a significant distance from the shores, and there are not many activities to do before reaching our next destination. This will be an appropriate exercise for us during this empty period.
从大湖回到陆地还有一段时间，毕竟在没有特别要做的事情的情况下，在镜像迷宫里获取资源和获得成长将是最合适的活动。

Executive Manager. I understand that you may feel uncomfortable going against your earlier orders.
经理，虽然您可能不喜欢推翻您所下的决定。

But consider the fact that this journey will continue on for quite some time. I believe that the resources and the combat experience that can be gained from this new area would be quite considerable.
考虑到我们剩下的旅程，我认为在这个新的空间里得到的资源和战斗经验难以忽视。

I nodded affirmatively. The Sinners each began grumbling and aired their woes... but they still prepared to head into the Dungeons once again.
我对那句话点了点头，罪人们一边表达着各自的不满，一边开始准备前往迷宫……

Thus we entered the newly formed door.
就这样，我们走进了新出现的门里。
